09.title: Stanford AI deployment three-body failure
09.caption: A 95%-accurate pneumonia diagnostic AI was shut down six months after deployment. The model worked; the coordination with radiologist workflow and hospital operations did not. Optimizing one body (capability) while ignoring the others produced resistance, liability ambiguity, and reimbursement refusal.
09.alt: Causal diagram. A 95%-accurate pneumonia diagnostic AI was shut down six months after deployment. The model worked; the coordination with radiologist workflow and hospital operations did not. Optimizing one body (capability) while ignoring the others produced resistance, liability ambiguity, and reimbursement refusal. Nodes: AI Capability, Radiologist Workflow, Hospital Operations, Deployment Outcome. Missing from the system: Integration Coordination. Links: AI Capability reduces Radiologist Workflow; AI Capability reduces Hospital Operations; Radiologist Workflow raises Deployment Outcome; Hospital Operations raises Deployment Outcome.
09.after: The technology worked. The coordination failed.

09.title: Chollet coordination death spiral
09.caption: Chollet's three bodies of technical debt form a reinforcing loop: more system complexity creates more integration overhead, which raises cognitive load, which spawns still more complexity. Good abstractions act as a latent balancing force that breaks the spiral when present.
09.alt: Causal diagram. 09.title: Raworth doughnut overshoot and shortfall
09.caption: Extractive growth lifts production but simultaneously breaches the ecological ceiling and fails to lift the social foundation. The planetary system pushes back (balancing) only after overshoot becomes severe, by which point the social shortfall persists. Regenerative distribution is the latent coordination layer that would land the economy in the doughnut.

09.title: Turkle conversation erosion loop
09.caption: Algorithmically-mediated communication trains fragmented attention and lowers tolerance for silence, eroding face-to-face conversation skill. Reduced skill makes in-person interaction less rewarding, driving still more mediated communication — a reinforcing loop Turkle calls the conversation crisis.
09.alt: Causal diagram. Algorithmically-mediated communication trains fragmented attention and lowers tolerance for silence, eroding face-to-face conversation skill. Links: Mediated Communication raises Fragmented Attention; Fragmented Attention reduces Conversation Skill; Conversation Skill reduces Mediated Communication; Conversation Skill raises Empathy Capacity. Loops: R1 — Conversation erosion.
09.after: Turkle explained that technology undermines connection when it mediates relation
